subject: [PATCH v7 5/5] mm/memcontrol: add stock to the memsw page counter

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch adds a separate stock to the memsw page counter, allowing it to operate independently of the memory bank. The common drain scheduling is factored into schedule_stock_drain(), which handles charge, refill, and hotplug operations for both stocks. If memory charge fails, only nr_pages from memsw are rolled back. The patch also preserves the user-visible cgroup-v1 memory invariant by reporting memory.usage_in_bytes as the smaller raw value.
